entries.fd3aca11e02f070b: As management challenges, the company says it will work on expanding sales of containers and bulk storage tanks, correcting selling prices, improving productivity and developing new products. In high-pressure gas cylinders, leveraging its accumulated technology and customer base, it is pursuing the capture of LP gas bulk storage tank replacement demand and the development of new fields, such as special gas cylinders for industrial gases used in IT industries and other sectors, and it is also developing high-pressure gas cylinders aimed at the Smart Gas Network Concept.
